# Data Source: identitynow_privilege_criteria

Use this data source to look up a privilege criteria by ID. Connector and single level criteria can be read as well as custom criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_privilege_criteria" "admins" {
  id = "2c9180867817ac4d017817c491119a20"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Privilege criteria ID.

### Read-Only

- `groups_json` (String) Criteria groups as a JSON array.
- `operator` (String) Logical operator between the groups.
- `privilege_level` (String) Privilege level assigned by the criteria.
- `source_id` (String) ID of the source the criteria applies to.
- `type` (String) Criteria type, `CUSTOM`, `CONNECTOR` or `SINGLE_LEVEL`.
